baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal كُنَّا and the predicate عِظَامًا نَخِرَةً.
baseline_models.mechanism: The clause carries the same first-person subject into a state where the body's hard joint-members have lost cohesion and crumbled; the skepticism treats material disintegration as a terminal break in both recoverable structure and personal continuity.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time let كُنَّا carry the same 'we' into the hypothesized decomposed state.
Solid bone supplies the body's durable structural remainder.
Decay, crumbling, and wind-hollowing remove that remainder's cohesion and make the state appear terminal.

changed_reading.before: A bare incredulous question about becoming bones.
changed_reading.after: The question makes loss of bodily cohesion carry the heavier claim that the same 'we' can no longer be structurally or temporally recovered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjective نَّخِرَةً attached directly to عِظَامًا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The adjective can profile not only age or rot but a hollow, air-traversed material condition: the former body-frame has become porous enough for wind and sound to pass through it.

activation_trace.role: The decayed bone or wood hollowed by wind gives نَّخِرَةً a porous material profile.
The gusting-wind image makes that porous decay dynamically traversable rather than merely inert.
The nasal sound image supplies a cautious acoustic edge to the hollow material state.

changed_reading.after: It may additionally evoke an emptied, air-permeable, potentially sounding skeleton, emphasizing changed material behavior rather than only elapsed decay.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ع ظ م in عِظَامًا immediately qualified by نَّخِرَةً.
baseline_models.mechanism: Although عِظَامًا is anatomical, its root inventory also carries greatness, honor, and self-magnification. Its contact with crumbling decay permits a branch echo in which bodily or social magnitude contracts into fragile residue.

activation_trace.role: Honor and social greatness supply the elevated pole latent in the shared root.
Self-magnification supplies the human posture that can be deflated.
Crumbling decay supplies the material low point into which magnitude collapses.

changed_reading.before: The phrase describes only the body's anatomical remains.
changed_reading.after: The anatomy may also carry a restrained anti-magnificence echo: what was treated as great ends as friable bone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surrounding objection names return to an initial condition and a repeated turn, while the answer reduces the transition to one voiced rebuke followed by abrupt presence. Decayed bones therefore cease to be a terminal endpoint and become one state in a sharply reversible sequence.

activation_trace.role: Presence in time anchors the focus state as one temporal phase rather than an absolute non-state.
Solid bones supply the material structure whose recovery is disputed.
Crumbling decay supplies the apparently irreversible condition that the sequence overturns.
Returning something to its place frames the disputed operation as restoration.
Return to the beginning specifies the restored endpoint as an earlier condition.
A return or repetition after a prior occurrence names recurrence explicitly.
A forceful vocal rebuke supplies the compact initiating event.
Numerical singleness collapses the imagined complexity of reversal into one impulse.

structural_cues: 79:10-14 forms a tight objection-answer sequence: return, decayed bones, losing recurrence, one rebuke, then sudden presence.
The branchless س ه ر occurrence at 79:14 contributes the abrupt surface endpoint through the فَإِذَا construction but is not branch-cited.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies restoration, return to a beginning, recurrence, one vocal rebuke, and the abrupt endpoint; I infer that the single impulse effects the transition from decomposed material to renewed presence. A live alternative is rhetorical compression rather than a description of material causation.

changed_reading.before: Decay makes return seem to require a slow reversal of every material loss.
changed_reading.after: The decayed-bone state is a reversible temporal phase crossed by one decisive command, with complexity belonging to the objectors' estimate rather than to the transition itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: The creation sequence describes measured origination, construction by joining parts, a load-bearing overhead, completion, solid masses, and anchoring. Against that sequence, bones read as the small-scale ribs and supports of a body-frame: their decay is failed structure awaiting reassembly, not disappearance of the capacity to structure.

activation_trace.role: Solid bone supplies the body's structural members for the scale analogy.
Crumbling and loss of interior cohesion specify the damaged condition of that frame.
Origination and bringing a creation into being supply the encompassing constructive capacity.
Ribs and supporting members directly bridge cosmic building language to a skeletal frame.
A roof that holds a construction supplies the load-bearing function of an ordered frame.
Straightness and completion supply the operation that turns parts into a whole.
A solid elevated aggregation supplies a macro-scale analogue for hard bodily members.
Fixing and stable anchoring supply the relational function that makes solid members structural.

structural_cues: 79:27 directly asks whether human creation is harder than the heaven and immediately answers with building activity.
79:27-32 moves through building, raising, completing, bringing out, and anchoring, a sequence of operations rather than a static inventory of objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cosmic construction operations and a branch that explicitly images ribs and supports; I infer a scale analogy in which skeletal bones are bodily building-members subject to the same ordering capacity. The live alternative is that the cosmic passage argues only from greater creation and does not model bodily reassembly step by step.

changed_reading.before: The bones are useless debris whose lost cohesion proves impossibility.
changed_reading.after: The bones become a ruined body-frame viewed within a larger grammar of joining, supporting, completing, and anchoring structures across scales.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context identifies a human who retrieves what was done and an inner self that made and restrained choices. The first-person 'we' in the focus therefore need not depend on intact bone for continuity: identity is also carried by recoverable action and accountable selfhood across the decomposed interval.

activation_trace.role: Presence across time anchors the same first-person plural subject inside the altered bodily state.
Material disintegration supplies the interval across which identity seems threatened.
Work and acquisition turn past striving into attributable conduct rather than vanished motion.
Retrieval after forgetting supplies renewed access to conduct across a lapse.
The self as the very identity of a thing supplies the accountable subject of remembered action.

structural_cues: 79:35 syntactically couples the human's remembering with what that human strove for.
79:37-41 sorts outcomes by prior transgression, preference, fear, and restraint, preserving attribution across the bodily transition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies remembered action, attributable work, and the self as identity; I infer that these provide continuity for the 'we' even when its skeletal substrate has decayed. A live alternative is that memory and identity are recreated or disclosed at judgment rather than continuously carried through the interval.

changed_reading.before: Personal continuity appears exhausted when the body's durable remainder crumbles.
changed_reading.after: The question becomes not only how matter returns but how an accountable subject returns with its own recoverable history of action and choice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus makes decay persuasive by letting a long material interval loom behind كُنَّا. The closing perception denies long remaining and brackets experienced duration between evening and morning, shrinking the very temporal scale on which decomposition had seemed decisive.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence in time makes the duration between former embodiment, decay, and renewed sight central to the focus question.
Advanced decay supplies the apparent evidence of a very long and consequential interval.
The morning span supplies one short temporal boundary for retrospective perception.
Remaining in a place supplies the duration explicitly denied as long.
Evening time supplies the other short temporal boundary.

structural_cues: 79:46 uses كَأَنَّهُمْ and the negated duration لَمْ يَلْبَثُوا to present an explicit retrospective rescaling of elapsed time.
The final evening-or-morning alternative mirrors the focus's temporal أَءِذَا construction while reversing its sense of an immense interval.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a decomposed state, temporal occurrence, denied long duration, and evening/morning limits; I infer that the closing rescaling reaches back to the interval magnified by the focus objection. A live alternative is that 79:46 compresses earthly life generally rather than the decomposed interval specifically.

changed_reading.before: The long time required for bones to decay makes return increasingly implausible.
changed_reading.after: From the endpoint, the decay-bearing interval loses its imagined immensity and can feel no longer than part of a day.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh's transgression culminates in a claim to supreme elevation and then in exemplary seizure. This narrative strengthens the focus root's honor, greatness, and self-magnification branches: 'decayed bones' can function as a leveling image in which asserted height and bodily magnitude are reduced to friable remainder.

activation_trace.role: Honor and standing supply the social magnitude that can be levelled.
Self-magnification gives that elevated magnitude a morally charged posture.
Crumbling decay supplies the common material condition beneath asserted status.
Crossing the limit in disobedience supplies the narrative's inflationary movement.
Greatness and domination make Pharaoh's claimed height an explicit form of self-magnification.
Exemplary punishment supplies the reversal that publicly collapses the claim.

structural_cues: 79:17-25 moves from transgression through the claim 'I am your highest lord' to seizure and exemplary punishment.
The episode is enclosed as an instructive crossing at 79:26, encouraging transfer from one magnified human posture to the focus speakers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a self-elevating ruler, a highest-status claim, punishment, and focus branches of honor and self-magnification; I infer a lexical and narrative bridge from عِظَام to collapsed greatness. The live alternative is that عِظَام is purely anatomical here and carries no status echo.

changed_reading.before: The speakers cite degraded anatomy as a neutral physical objection.
changed_reading.after: Their image can also level human pretension: even the self that enlarges its standing reaches the same crumbling skeletal condition and remains answerable beyond it.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the 'no one there' branch is an idiom and not the ordinary sense of نَّخِرَةً. It remains anchored in the exact focus root beside كُنَّا's presence-in-time branch, so it can preserve a live presence/absence echo. Downstream prose should present it only as a branch resonance, never as a translation or a claim that the adjective literally means nonexistence here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of كُنَّا with the root ن خ ر in نَّخِرَةً.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence in time supply the clause's explicit 'we were' pole.
The idiom using ناخر for 'anyone' supplies an extinction-of-occupancy echo at the decomposed pole.

changed_reading.before: The question contrasts living persons only with degraded material.
changed_reading.after: It may momentarily stage presence against absence: 'we were/present' is imagined at a root-edge where no person seems left in the residue.

strongest_changes: The immediate sequence turns terminal decay into a reversible state crossed by one vocal impulse.
The cosmic construction sequence recasts bones as damaged structural members within a larger grammar of joining, support, completion, and anchoring.
Remembered striving and the accountable self relocate continuity from intact matter alone to recoverable personal history.
The closing evening-or-morning perspective compresses the long interval on which the decay objection depends.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah package repeatedly changed the scale and domain of the focus: material decay became sudden reversal, structural engineering, accountable identity, temporal rescaling, and, more cautiously, the leveling of human greatness.
remaining_uncertainties: The construction passage may offer a greater-creation argument without specifying a mechanism of bodily reassembly.
The final compressed duration may refer to earthly life generally rather than specifically to the period of decomposition.
The greatness/status and presence/absence readings are branch echoes and should not displace the anatomical sense.
The hollow acoustic profile of نَّخِرَةً is materially grounded in the inventory but remains exploratory in this syntax.
